name: claude-plugins-official
description: Official, Anthropic-managed directory of high quality Claude Code Plugins.
one_liner: An official, curated catalog of add-ons for Claude Code, so developers can browse and install trusted extensions in one place.
buyer: Not a product for end customers — the value here is discovery for plugin authors, not something to resell as-is.
business_use_cases: A plugin author submits their tool for listing to reach every Claude Code user searching for that capability.
A dev tools agency scans the directory for gaps and builds the missing plugin first.
A security-conscious team builds a paid audit service reviewing plugins before their org installs them (the repo itself warns plugins aren't vetted).

money_ideas.idea: Sell a 'trusted plugin audit' report for enterprises worried about supply-chain risk from unreviewed plugins.

steal_this: Build and sell a paid security-audit report for the top 20 most-installed Claude Code plugins — the official docs literally say nobody else is checking.
